user.title: Energy Sharing setup
user.description: Configure solar energy sharing settlement between households. Select the receiving household grid-import Utility Meter, the allocated shared-energy Utility Meter, and how the allocation percentage is provided.

data.name: Integration name
data.shared_energy_entity: Allocated shared energy Utility Meter (15 min)

data_description.grid_import_entity: Utility Meter reporting receiving household grid import for the last completed interval (must expose last_period).
data_description.shared_energy_entity: Utility Meter reporting allocated shared energy for the last completed interval (must expose last_period).
data_description.percentage_entity: Entity providing the allocation percentage, such as an input_number or sensor.
data_description.fixed_percentage: Fixed allocation percentage stored in the integration options.

error.duplicate_entities: The grid import and shared energy entities must be different.
error.invalid_utility_meter: The selected entity is unavailable or does not expose a valid last_period attribute.
error.invalid_percentage_entity: The selected percentage entity is unavailable or does not provide a numeric value.

abort.already_configured: This entity pair is already configured.

init.title: Energy Sharing options
init.description: Source entities: grid import `{grid_import_entity}`, shared energy `{shared_energy_entity}`, percentage mode `{percentage_mode}`{percentage_entity, select, other {, percentage entity `{percentage_entity}`}, empty {}}. These identity settings cannot be changed here.

error.invalid_percentage: The allocation percentage must be greater than zero.

process_now.name: Process now
process_now.description: Attempt to process the latest completed interval for the selected Energy Sharing device.

reset_totals.name: Reset totals
reset_totals.description: Reset all cumulative energy totals and interval counters. Source Utility Meters are not changed.

confirm.name: Confirm reset
confirm.description: Must be set to true to confirm resetting cumulative totals.
